mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% fails to produce a positive Rank IC (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a contraction in household spending and investment, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior 3-month average
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 3 consecutive months, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 90.0 (relative to 2017=100) during a supply shock regime signals a contraction in manufacturing output that increases corporate input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a supply shock regime, INDPRO < 90.0 fails to predict negative 60-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, the average 20-day forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls consistently indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is rising, the Rank IC for predicting positive 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 600.0 thousand units during a housing market boom regime signals increased consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a housing market boom regime, HOUST > 600.0 fails to predict positive 60-day forward returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is rising, the Rank IC for predicting positive 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
